Package de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin

Class OAuth2RestClient

java.lang.Object
de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin.OAuth2RestClient
public class OAuth2RestClient extends Object
Client for the OAuth2/OIDC endpoints of the identity provider. Exchanges an authorization code for tokens and reads the user claims from the userinfo endpoint.

AdvancedHttpClient of the core is used on purpose instead of a own http client: it honours the proxy settings of SCM-Manager and takes part in its tracing (spanKind).

Error handling follows one rule: every failure becomes an AuthenticationException, because every caller is part of a login. Status codes 400, 401 and 403 are accepted explicitly, otherwise the client would throw before the status can be logged with a useful message.

  • Method Details

    • exchangeCodeForToken

      public TokenResponse exchangeCodeForToken(String code, String redirectUri, String codeVerifier)
      Redeems the authorization code at the token endpoint (rfc 6749, section 4.1.3). The client authenticates itself with client id and secret in the form body.
      Parameters:
      code - authorization code of the callback
      redirectUri - callback url of the authorization request, has to be identical
      codeVerifier - pkce verifier, omitted if null or empty
      Returns:
      access token and, if the provider issues one, the id token
      Throws:
      org.apache.shiro.authc.AuthenticationException - if the request fails, the status is not 200 or the response contains no access token

    • fetchUserInfo

      public com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode fetchUserInfo(String accessToken)
      Reads the claims of the authenticated user from the userinfo endpoint.

      Note for troubleshooting: which claims appear here is decided by the identity provider. In keycloak a protocol mapper has to have "Add to userinfo" enabled, otherwise the claim exists in the token but not in this response.

      Parameters:
      accessToken - access token of the code exchange
      Returns:
      the parsed userinfo response
      Throws:
      org.apache.shiro.authc.AuthenticationException - if the request fails or the status is not 200
